name: A-Leads
description: A-Leads B2B data: company-level filter search (firmographics, funding, web traffic, tech, hiring, and sales-motion signals), lookalike companies, people/contact discovery, work-email finding, phone finding, and email verification.
author: the upstream workspace (custom)

companySearch.name: Company Search
companySearch.description: Company-level filter search (Layer 1). Returns company records matching firmographic, funding, web-traffic, sales-motion, tech, and hiring filters. Bills per record returned.
companySearch.instructions: Build an ICP company universe. Every filter is optional - combine them for precision. Headcount uses integer buckets: 1=1, 2=2-10, 3=11-50, 4=51-200, 5=201-500, 6=501-1000, 7=1001-5000, 8=5001-10000, 9=10001+. Page with current_page (0-indexed); increment until results come back empty. Auth is the x-api-key header - never send Authorization: Bearer (A-Leads returns 400). A 500 with no message usually means the endpoint is plan-gated on this key; contact support@a-leads.co to activate.

bulk_domains.description: Domains to include, one per line or comma-separated (e.g. acme.com,salesforce.com).

company_type.description: Privately Held | Public Company | Self-Owned | Partnership | Self-Employed | Nonprofit | Educational | Government Agency.

ownership_status.description: Private | Public | Investment Company | NGO/NPO/NFP/Organization/Association | Government | Product/Brand/Service | SPAC.

mapped_company_size.description: Headcount buckets as integers (1..9; see instructions for the mapping).

hq_location.description: Country or city, e.g. United States, Seattle.

experimental_industries.description: Industry sector text (experimental; can reduce result count).

last_funding_round_name.description: e.g. Seed Round, Series A, Series B, Series C, Angel Round, Venture Round.

job_posting_title.description: Job titles currently being recruited (a hiring-velocity proxy).

pricing_available.description: Company has a clear pricing page.

request_uuid.description: Optional tracking ID for this run.

similarCompanies.name: Similar Companies
similarCompanies.description: Find companies similar to known companies, given A-Leads company IDs (integers returned in company-search results).
similarCompanies.instructions: Pass company_ids you got from a prior Company Search result. Paginate with page and page_size.

company_ids.description: A-Leads company IDs as strings, e.g. ["6068905","6068904"].

advancedSearch.name: Advanced People Search
advancedSearch.description: People search with both person-level and company-level filters. Returns person records (LinkedIn profiles) with company context attached.
advancedSearch.instructions: Use for ICP contact discovery - combine title/seniority/department with company firmographics. is_job_title_strict=true means exact-title match, false (default) is fuzzy. search_type is new | saved | total. Pass the returned document_id into Find Work Email for the best match accuracy.

is_job_title_strict.description: true = exact title match only; false = fuzzy/related titles.

member_management_level.description: Specialist | Manager | Owner | Founder | President/Vice President | Director | Senior | Head | C-Level | Partner | Intern.

bulk_domains.description: Company domains, one per line or comma-separated.

findEmail.name: Find Work Email
findEmail.description: Find a person's work email from their name and company domain (Layer 2).
findEmail.instructions: Provide first_name, last_name, and website (the company domain). If the person came from an Advanced People Search result, pass its document_id to improve match accuracy.

document_id.description: Person record ID from an Advanced People Search result (improves accuracy).

findPhone.name: Find Phone
findPhone.description: Find a phone number from a LinkedIn profile (Layer 2).
findPhone.instructions: Input is a LinkedIn profile URL or its slug (e.g. john-doe-15).

verifyEmail.name: Verify Email
verifyEmail.description: Verify whether an email address is deliverable (Layer 2).

reverseEmailVerify.name: Reverse Email Lookup + Verify
reverseEmailVerify.description: Reverse-lookup and verify an email address. Body sends email at the top level (no data wrapper).

email.description: Email address to reverse-lookup and verify.
